All 7 full.phases[N].side rows disagreed with the already-correct content win[N]/whys[N]: rows 0-1 read 'Brand' where content says even (Skill), rows 2-5 read 'Skill' where content says Brand leads, and row 6 read 'Skill' where content says Zilean wins back the late game.
audit.why: Every single row of the level-advantage bar argued the opposite (or a diluted version) of the sentence printed under it — level 3 shows 'Skill/even' next to a paragraph that says 'Brand leads as his Q-W-E combo out-damages your poke with no sustain to answer.'
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to match the already-correct win[N] (Skill, Skill, Brand, Brand, Brand, Brand, Zilean), adjusted ratings to match direction, and rewrote phases[2].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why and phases[5].why (which described Zilean-favoring events) to state the Brand-favoring interaction the content layer already argues. Row 6's why already matched the Zilean verdict, so it was left alone. No win[] edits needed — content already held the correct chart.

edits.before: Double-bomb stun live: Q-W-Q is the lane's longest-range stun setup.
edits.after: His Q-W-E combo and burn out-damage your poke; no sustain answers it.

edits.before: Bank XP and chip the margins — your duo levels early and spikes rude.
edits.after: Repeated combos and passive stacking win every extended trade against you.

edits.before: Chronoshift online — their kill math now includes an undo button.
edits.after: Pyroclasm adds huge AoE burst that your revive can't pre-empt.

edits.before: First item: the bombs chunk and the speed warps decide every chase.
edits.after: A full combo can nearly kill your carry through your heal-free kit.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Time Warp banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Sear (Q, 8-6s) only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. The duo's tempo bends around its cooldown. - Keep E Time Warp (15s) banked for his all-in. - The 100/90/80s R is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Q the carry, W, Q the stun, walk — the double-bomb chunk that started as chip.
edits.after: Land the first Q to tag him, second Q on top — double stun is the setup.

edits.before: Spending the R on a survivable catch — the undo insures deaths, not discomfort.
edits.after: Chronoshift undoes a death, not damage taken. Save it for the kill, not a poke.
